jamie_sales: quick heads-up — AcquaBank POC is asking for a compliance evidence bundle and a signed pen-test attestation. timeline: they want everything before EOW next Friday. they also asked for dedicated pricing for a 3-month trial (reserved capacity). can we assemble? :eyes:

alex_security: we can. need to confirm the exact artifacts they want. typical bundle: (1) SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), (2) SOC 2 controls matrix, (3) signed penetration test attestation/letter, (4) ISO27001 scope & cert (if available), (5) summary of encryption/KMS and access controls. any additions? :memo:

ryan_engineer: clarification — POC is planned on Dedicated (VPC) per the commercial note. they want assurance on log isolation and key ownership (customer KMS). do we have a standard KMS integration diagram we can include?

jamie_sales: yes dedicated. customer explicitly requires customer-managed keys. they also asked about sample onboarding runbook and a short note on SLA/uptime for dedicated clusters. pricing question: can we provide a 3-month reserved price with an upgrade path to annual? they want ballpark by EOD.

alex_security: on the pen-test attestation — we have a templated pen-test letter we can sign after legal approves. we typically require a completed NDA or LOA before sharing full redacted SOC2 PDF. we can, however, provide the controls matrix and a redacted summary now. I'll draft the pen-test attestation and drop it here for review.

laura_legal: pinged. for the pen-test letter we need the customer's signatory + LOA. we can generate a one-page LOA template. send me the customer's legal contact and the POC SOW. once LOA is signed, security can sign the attestation.

alex_security: draft checklist for Jamie to deliver to customer:
- LOA/NDA (signed)
- business contact & legal contact
- confirmation they're okay with a redacted SOC2 (we redact vendor-specific endpoint info)
- target date for POC start

alex_security: quick copy of artifact list we can hand off:
1) "SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf" (redaction: infra IPs, internal hostnames)
2) "SOC2_controls_matrix.csv"
3) "pen_test_attestation_template.pdf" (needs signature + LOA)
4) "ISO27001_scope_summary.pdf"
5) "Dedicated_deployment_security_overview.pdf" (includes KMS flow)

ryan_engineer: i can attach the KMS integration diagram and a short runbook snippet. snippet:
```
# onboarding notes
1. provision VPC peering
2. configure customer KMS alias
3. deploy dedicated cluster with private subnets
4. validate network egress rules
```

jamie_sales: perfect — i'll ask for LOA + legal contact and confirm they accept redacted SOC2. i'll also ask for expected concurrency/throughput so we can firm pricing. will update here.

deploy-bot: created POC ticket POC-4521 for AcquaBank (assignee: jamie_sales). link: https://redwood.internal/POC-4521 :robot_face:

laura_legal: added — sending LOA template now to jamie in DM. once we have signed LOA, i'll route pen-test letter to alex for signature.

alex_security: timeline wise — we can assemble the controls matrix and dedicated security overview today, but pen-test letter depends on LOA signing. expected turnaround after LOA: 24-48h.

jamie_sales: thanks all. i'll loop in the customer's legal (susan.lane@acquabank.com) and request LOA + throughput numbers. aim to get initial bundle (controls matrix + overview) to them by tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex_security: acked. i'll prepare the redaction-ready SOC2 and pen-test attestation draft.

ryan_engineer: i'll attach diagrams to the POC ticket.

jamie_sales: closing loop — will post updates here once LOA received.
